rows.text: Known gotcha in acme-platform web app: the sign-in redirect loop happens when /login is missing from publicRoutes in apps/web/middleware.ts, and afterSignInUrl must be /dashboard (login page and NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_IN_URL) or it bounces.
State management in the acme-platform web app: server state is TanStack Query, client state is zustand, and the two must not be mixed.
Worker tests run with `pnpm --filter worker test` and use an in-memory Redis mock (ioredis-mock), so no real Redis is needed.
Logging convention in acme-platform: use pino with structured logs; no console.log.
Issues are tracked in Linear under the ACME team; branch names start with the lowercase Linear id, e.g. acme-123-short-slug.
The acme-platform API is Express 4; it verifies Clerk session JWTs with @clerk/backend in apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts (requireAuth), and returns 401 with token_expired / invalid_token on failure.
Versioning in acme-platform uses Changesets: run `pnpm changeset` for anything user-facing (e.g. the invoice timezone change counted).
Standing rule from Jordan: never run destructive database commands (drop, truncate, reset) without asking first, even on the local database.

In the last game day an RDS failover took 90 seconds; the API rides it out by retrying DB connections for 2 minutes (connectRetryWindowMs 120_000 in apps/api/src/db/pool.ts), so that window must stay >= 2 minutes.
Invoice dates in the web app are shown in the org's time zone (org.timeZone, via formatDate(iso, timeZone)), not UTC; Vancouver agencies had seen the wrong day.

The acme CLI (packages/cli) is bundled with tsup into dist/index.js (single ESM file, node18 target, shebang banner, bin `acme`); commands are commander Commands in src/commands/ registered in src/index.ts.

Onboarding gotcha: on Apple Silicon, sharp and canvas need Rosetta-free builds (do not run the terminal under Rosetta); after switching Node versions run `pnpm rebuild sharp` or image uploads in the dashboard crash on startup.
API tests in acme-platform run against a real database started by Testcontainers, so Docker must be running; if Docker is stopped the suite hangs rather than failing (check `docker info`).

Ops runbook facts: background jobs retry with exponential backoff (5 attempts), then go to dead-letter queue `dlq` and alert in Slack #alerts; production Postgres is RDS Multi-AZ with 14-day backups and restores go to a new instance, never over the live one; deploy rollback docs are still a TODO.
API health endpoint is GET /healthz (localhost:4000); it checks Postgres and Redis and returns 200 only when both are up.
Licensing: the acme-platform repo is proprietary (root LICENSE, all rights reserved, Acme Inc.), while packages/cli is MIT licensed (packages/cli/LICENSE).

Jordan states the acme-platform database is MySQL 8 (docs/architecture.md Data section now says so; the API owns the schema and migrations live in apps/api/migrations). Some docs/comments elsewhere still say Postgres.
The worker consumes RabbitMQ queues (invoices.reminders, webhooks.outbound, exports), one consumer per queue.

Build error "Module not found: Can't resolve 'fs'" means a server-only module was imported into a client bundle; fix by adding `import "server-only"` to the module and keeping it out of client components (use a server component or route handler).
`pnpm dev` at the repo root starts web, api and worker together via Turborepo.
Rule: never hand-edit generated files under dist/ or *.gen.ts (regenerate instead).

packages/cli/dist/index.js is still tracked in git (force-added despite dist/ being gitignored) and was hand-patched by Marco Bianchi in a91c3e2 (2026-07-08); it is stale. Jordan said to ask Marco first and leave it for now.

Error reporting goes to Sentry (DSN from SENTRY_DSN env var), including CLI failures; feature flags are managed in GrowthBook (the invoices export command is behind flag cli-invoices-export, which still needs creating in GrowthBook).
CLI tests (packages/cli) are Vitest snapshot tests of stdout.
Standing rule from Jordan: never use git stash; commit work in progress to the branch instead.

Node version is 18 LTS everywhere (worker included): do not use Node 20+ APIs such as toSorted, toReversed, Object.groupBy, Array.fromAsync, Promise.withResolvers. Known leftover: Object.groupBy in apps/web/lib/group.ts (swap for reduce, deferred).
Run the acme CLI locally from source with `pnpm --filter @acme/cli dev -- <args>` (tsx, no build needed); point at an API with ACME_API_URL (e.g. https://api.staging.example.com).

invoice-reminder job (services/worker/src/jobs/invoice-reminder.ts) is idempotent via db.reminderLog.claim(invoiceId, kind, sentOn) on table reminder_log (unique invoice_id/kind/sent_on); RabbitMQ redeliveries had caused customers to get duplicate reminders.

The worker Docker image uses node:20-slim with libvips from apt (not alpine like the api) on purpose: sharp segfaults on the alpine musl image (Priya Shah, e22b9d0, April 2026). To shrink it, use a multi-stage build copying only production node_modules.
Excel garbles accented names in CSV exports (e.g. Cafe Lumiere); the CLI invoices export has a --bom flag (off by default, CSV only) that prefixes a UTF-8 BOM.
Merge rule: every PR needs one approval from CODEOWNERS and green CI. .github/CODEOWNERS has no line for packages/cli/ (falls back to @acme/eng-leads); worth adding an owner before the CLI export PR.

The API talks to the database through PgBouncer in transaction mode, so prepared statements must be disabled (prepare: false). Added to pool.ts and the options type in driver.ts, but the driver does not yet pass it to the raw pool.
The api and worker run on EKS; the cluster is named acme-prod (use for logs).

The repo root pins yarn 1.22.22 (packageManager field, yarn.lock v1, no pnpm lockfile) and CI runs `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`; a branch that changes package.json must commit the updated yarn.lock or the CI install step fails.

Secrets: team/dev secrets live in the 1Password vault acme-dev; production secrets live in AWS Secrets Manager. In .env.example put only a placeholder with a comment saying where to get the value (e.g. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_replace_me).
Web styling is Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS-first config in apps/web/app/globals.css (@theme tokens like brand, warn, radius-card); there is no tailwind.config.js and none should be created.
Paging for Stripe webhook failures: the CloudWatch alarm api-stripe-webhook-5xx (more than 5 5xx in 5 min) notifies SNS topic pagerduty-oncall, so the PagerDuty on-call is woken at night.
Linting and formatting use Biome: run `pnpm lint` at the repo root (biome check .); `pnpm biome check --write <path>` autofixes; max line width 120.
Autoscaling: the worker scales with KEDA on queue length (1 to 20 replicas, one per 50 messages); the api uses HPA on CPU at 70% (3 to 12 pods). Manifests in infra/k8s/.

Cost tagging rule: every taggable AWS/Terraform resource needs tags team and env (Priya's script flags anything without them). Jordan's team tag is team=payments. Only aws_s3_bucket is taggable among a bucket's sub-resources.

Exports bucket (infra/s3-exports.tf on branch acme-424-exports-bucket): acme-<env>-exports, private, AES256, objects expire after 30 days; planned for the CLI export to write files to S3 later. Plan for staging was 4 to add, not applied.

Jordan has a personal hiking app called trailmix (Django + htmx, /Users/jordan/code/trailmix). Double-submit of the add-hike form is prevented with hx-disabled-elt and hx-sync="this:drop"; GPX uploads are validated by hikes/validators.py validate_gpx (defusedxml, GPX 1.0/1.1 namespace, trkpt/rtept, 10 MB cap); htmx forms need hx-encoding="multipart/form-data" for uploads.
Staging API returns brief 502s (~40s) during deploys; the CLI api client (packages/cli/src/api.ts apiGet) retries 502/503/504 up to 3 attempts with 500ms/1s backoff plus jitter.

The API omits lineItems for draft invoices (routes/invoices.ts), so in the web app Invoice.lineItems is optional and must be guarded (crashed InvoiceLineItems/InvoiceTotals on draft detail pages in prod, Sentry WEB-1F3).

The monorepo is orchestrated by Turborepo (task pipelines in turbo.json; build depends on ^build and openapi). The OpenAPI spec apps/api/openapi.yaml is generated from zod schemas (apps/api/src/schemas) with `pnpm turbo run openapi --filter api`; never hand-edit the YAML.
Releasing the CLI: merge the Changesets version PR, then the publish job runs `npm publish --provenance`.
CI fails if line coverage drops below 80%; add tests for new route behavior.
Preference: when finished with a task, Jordan wants a short bullet-list summary, not paragraphs.
Business rule: only invoices with status open can be overdue; drafts and voided invoices never count (dashboard OverdueBadge counts open invoices past due only).
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:, with optional scope like fix(web):).
Update docs/ pages when public behavior changes (e.g. new CLI commands go in docs/cli.md).

In the web app, Skeleton (components/ui/Skeleton) is a default export plus SkeletonText; InvoiceRow was renamed InvoiceListItem (and InvoiceRowProps to InvoiceListItemProps) in acme-431-overdue-badge-drafts, which will conflict with Lena's in-progress branch. OrgSummary type lacks timeZone (Org has it).

Resetting the local acme DB to a clean seeded state: stop db, remove the docker volume acme-platform_dbdata, `docker compose up -d db redis`, then run apps/api/scripts/migrate.ts (47 migrations) and seed.ts (3 orgs, 9 users, 24 clients, 180 invoices). Destructive: needs Jordan's explicit ok first.

Team ownership (CODEOWNERS): Lena Fischer owns apps/web with the frontend team; Marco Bianchi owns apps/api and services/worker with the backend team; Priya Shah owns infra/ and .github/ with the platform team; Sam asked Jordan to review new-hire onboarding docs.

The acme CLI `acme login` uses the OAuth device code flow (prints a user code, approve in browser) and stores the token in the OS keychain via keytar (service 'acme-cli'). As of 2026-08-22 it has a deadline from expires_in, backs off 5s on slow_down, and fails with exit code 1 on denied/expired.
Production Redis for the acme-platform worker is AWS ElastiCache, single shard, cluster mode off.

Marco wants the worker's rate limiter (services/worker/src/ratelimit.ts) to keep counters in Redis in prod instead of in memory. Review found take() is not atomic (should be a Lua script, ~3.4x faster, 0 over-limit admits vs 37), reset() uses blocking KEYS (use SCAN), and the Redis path has no test.

Never edit a migration that has been merged; add a new migration instead. Example: 0042 (invoice reminders) shipped with invoices.reminder_days default 7, fixed by new 0043_fix_reminder_days_default.sql to default 3.
Do not rewrite or squash commits that are already pushed; Marco branches off the user's branches. Add new commits on top.

Worker outage on Saturday 2026-08-22: prod Redis hit maxmemory (noeviction) because BullMQ queues (invoices, emails, webhooks) kept completed jobs forever (bull:emails:completed had 1.78M entries). Fixed with removeOnComplete: 1000 in services/worker/src/queues.ts (PR #819); removeOnFail is 5000.

PostHog analytics in apps/web is initialised in apps/web/app/providers.tsx (PostHogProvider, capture_pageview false). An invoice_sent event is captured from the invoice send button (Lena asked for it).
Helm charts live in infra/helm, one chart per service (api, web, worker), each with values.yaml and values-prod.yaml.

ESLint and Prettier were dropped in favour of Biome (PR #512, 2026-03-11). Lint is `biome check .`. Do not add .eslintrc.json or .prettierrc (e.g. Lena's PR wrongly added them to apps/api; ask her to delete them).
API CORS (apps/api/src/app.ts) allows only origins listed in the CORS_ORIGINS env var (comma separated), nothing else; requests with no Origin header still pass.

The acme CLI (packages/cli) is built with yargs; commands live in packages/cli/src/commands. `acme invoices list` supports --status and --json; `acme invoices overdue` is a shortcut for list --status overdue. CLI tests use vitest.

Gotcha: invoice dueDate is a plain calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC midnight and shows the previous day west of UTC (Vancouver, Toronto). Parse as local with `${dueDate}T00:00:00` (fixed in invoice-row.tsx).

Money formatting in apps/web goes through formatMoney(cents, currency, locale='en-CA') in apps/web/lib/money.ts (cached Intl.NumberFormat, handles JPY zero-decimal); the <Money> component and export page use it. Do not hard-code cents / 100.

Invoice attachment uploads do not go through the API: browser calls POST /v1/uploads to get a presigned S3 PUT URL (valid 300s), PUTs the file straight to S3, then calls POST /v1/uploads/:id/complete. Upload progress needs XMLHttpRequest (xhr.upload.onprogress); Lena wants a progress bar.
API data-access naming convention: list* functions (e.g. getInvoicesForClient was renamed listClientInvoices in 2026-08).
Never run `terraform apply` (or any infra apply) from a laptop; only the CI plan/apply workflow applies (rule from Priya). Running `terraform plan` locally to paste into the PR is fine.

Infra in infra/ is Terraform (infra/s3.tf, env values in infra/envs/staging.tfvars); the uploads bucket CORS origins come from var upload_origins (staging now includes https://app.staging.acme.example.com).

Reconcile decision: Stripe payment allocations pointing at soft-deleted invoices are treated as unapplied (reconcile.ts sumAllocations skips them; db.invoicesByIds filters deleted_at). Previously crashed with TypeError 'amountCents' on the Stripe webhook; fixed in commit 5a7e2c9.

Invoice PDF filenames are INV-2026-0412-northwind-creative.pdf style: number plus slugified client name (accents stripped, max 60 chars), falling back to number.pdf if the slug is empty. Implemented in apps/api/src/pdf/filename.ts pdfFilename.

CODEOWNERS: the platform team (@acme/platform, Priya's team) owns /infra/ and /.github/ and is auto-requested as reviewer; apps/web is @acme/frontend, apps/api, services/worker and packages/cli are @acme/backend. The reorg (#744) had wrongly written /infrastructure/; fixed on branch acme-239-codeowners-infra.

The @acme/cli package is ESM-only since PR #702 (CJS bundle dropped). ERR_REQUIRE_ESM from customers means an old Node; tell them to upgrade to Node 18+ and reinstall with `npm i -g @acme/cli`. An `engines` field in the CLI package.json was suggested but not added.

Billing code (apps/api/src/billing/ and services/worker/src/jobs/billing/) must not change without Jordan's (the user's) review, even small fixes; open a draft PR and tag Jordan. Applies to Claude and to contractors.

Local env setup: copy each app's .env.example (apps/api, apps/web, services/worker) to .env.local, NOT .env (the web app ignores plain .env), and get secrets from the 1Password vault acme-dev. Then `docker compose up -d db redis` and `pnpm dev`. Documented in docs/onboarding.md.

apps/web uses Clerk middleware in apps/web/middleware.ts, which protects every route except those in the publicRoutes matcher; any new public page (e.g. /pricing, added 2026-08-24) must be added there.

The /pricing page (apps/web/app/(marketing)/pricing, PR #824) was built for marketing with placeholder prices (Starter 29, Studio 79, Agency 199 per month); marketing must confirm real prices. Use theme tokens like ring-primary, not hard-coded colors.

Runtime validation uses zod everywhere (no joi, no hand-rolled ifs). API request schemas live in apps/api/src/schemas/ (uploads.ts, clients.ts with a .strict() createClientBody); routes use safeParse and return 400 invalid_body.

API list endpoints take ?sort= (createdAt, dueDate, total, number) and ?dir= (asc/desc) via apps/api/src/lib/paging.ts; sorting in web tables is server-side. Reviewer suggested syncing sort to the URL (nuqs / useSearchParams), not yet done.
Local dev ports: web 3000, api 4000, worker metrics 9464 (/metrics), Postgres 5432, Redis 6379. Start with `docker compose up -d db redis` then `pnpm dev` (turbo).

Infra is now Pulumi in TypeScript (infra/Pulumi.yaml, stacks staging and prod, code in infra/src: queues.ts, buckets.ts, rds.ts, cluster.ts, alarms/, tags.ts). Remaining Terraform lives in infra/legacy-terraform/ until migrated. SQS queues follow queues.ts pattern: queue plus DLQ with redrivePolicy, tags(...).

Priya wants an SQS queue for the CSV exports feature; none exists yet in staging or prod (existing: webhooks-inbound, webhooks-dlq, emails-bounce). Suggested names exports-jobs and exports-dlq, added in infra/src/queues.ts. Not created yet.

No Node version is pinned in acme-platform (no .nvmrc, .node-version, .tool-versions or engines). Jordan wants it pinned (.nvmrc at root plus engines in root package.json) because new hires end up on Homebrew's node; the Node major was still to be decided. Note root package.json packageManager says yarn@1.22.22 although the repo uses pnpm.

On staging, PR #828 (Lena Fischer's move of auth pages into the (auth) route group) caused an ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS sign-in loop (new auth page URL treated as protected). Lena is fixing it; do not touch it.

Jordan works in Toronto time (EDT, UTC-4). Tests that compare local dates with toISOString() (UTC) fail after ~8pm Toronto, so tests must pin the clock with fake timers and be checked under TZ=America/Toronto and TZ=UTC (fixed invoice-filters.test.tsx).

Priya wants a prod alarm that pages oncall before the worker's Redis fills up again (cf. 2026-08-22). Draft infra/src/alarms/worker.ts: memory > 80% for 10 min via the PagerDuty topic; namespace and metric are still TODO (prod Redis is ElastiCache so likely CloudWatch AWS/ElastiCache). Not merged. The 14 existing prod CloudWatch alarms route to the pagerduty-oncall SNS topic and none cover worker Redis.

Reminder email subjects (services/worker/src/jobs/send-reminder.ts reminderSubject): 'Reminder: INV-... is due in N days', 'Reminder: INV-... is due today', or 'INV-... is N days overdue' (singular day when 1), computed in UTC calendar days.

Gotcha: imports must match file name case exactly (money.tsx, copy-button.tsx). macOS filesystem is case-insensitive so a wrong-case import builds locally but fails on the Linux CI runner with 'Module not found'.

Forms in apps/web use react-hook-form with zodResolver (@hookform/resolvers/zod); examples: invoices/new/invoice-form.tsx, settings/org-form.tsx, clients/[id]/edit/client-form.tsx (name, email, currency CAD/USD/EUR/GBP, tax id).

Jordan's standing rule: test changes end to end in the running app before opening a PR, not only unit tests, and say what was checked. Reason: a date picker change passed unit tests but was broken in the real browser.

Invoice due dates in the acme web app are shown in the viewer's browser timezone (Intl.DateTimeFormat, no explicit timeZone) via formatDueDate in apps/web/lib/dates.ts, because some users are in Vancouver and UTC showed the wrong day.

Gotcha: the acme API invoice endpoint only includes lineItems when the request passes expand=lineItems. The cached list row has no lineItems, so invoice detail can see invoice.lineItems undefined and crash on .map. A real fix (always request expand=lineItems in the detail query) was proposed but not confirmed.

acme-platform pins Node 20.11 in .nvmrc (moved off Node 18 on 2026-08-27, commit b71c0de); package.json engines is >=20.11 <21. Run `nvm install` once then `nvm use` before installing dependencies, otherwise install fails with an engines error (Jordan's new laptop had Node 18.20.4).

Jordan's rule: never run long benchmarks on the shared CI runners (they slow everyone down); run benchmarks locally. Do not add the PDF render bench as a CI job. It is local-only: services/worker/scripts/bench-pdf.ts refuses to run when CI is set.

Plan, still open: the reminder job (services/worker/src/jobs/sendReminder.ts) was made idempotent (sentAt check, conditional claim on claimedAt, idempotencyKey to the mailer), but it needs a new Prisma migration adding a nullable reminder.claimedAt column. The migration is not written yet; Jordan said later.

Worker queue concurrency is 5 jobs per process (WORKER_CONCURRENCY env var, services/worker/src/queues.ts). For the end-of-month reminder backlog the recommendation was to raise the max replica count (the worker autoscales on queue length) rather than raise per-process concurrency, since higher concurrency means more DB connections and mail sockets per process.

Jordan has a Django side project called trailmix (htmx forms, e.g. hikes app at /Users/jordan/code/trailmix). Fixed a double-post: a submit button had its own hx-post in addition to the form's, so only the form should carry hx-* attributes.
Invoice export CSV columns use snake_case headers; the amount column is now amount_cents (was amountCents), per finance. Anyone parsing the old header needs updating; worth a release note.
